description: WaterBenchmarkHub indexes and distributes water-network benchmarks through a website and Python package, with benchmark data and evaluation functions for comparable experiments. This resource is provided by WaterFutures (repository owner). Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: MIT. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Individual benchmark licences and assumptions must be checked separately from the hub software licence. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
